description:
Get portfolio performance statistics (returns, allocation, risk).

    gross_exposure and net_exposure are in book currency. A weight may be
    negative. dividend_income is cash by stock and can be negative when a
    short owes the dividend. total_gain is unrealized_pnl + realized_pnl.
    Do not add dividend_income on top of total_gain.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
name: get_portfolio_statistics
title: Get portfolio statistics
